title: Devi's configured access request
description: One existing finance account, manager approval, and automated fulfillment. A logical teaching flow, not private ISC service architecture or a universal request sequence.

diagrams.title: From a request to a checked result
diagrams.accessibility: Devi submits a request in ISC. Her manager approves or rejects it. Rejection stops this request without a grant. Approval allows ISC to initiate a change through the connector. The application either adds the permission or rejects the operation in the illustrated cases. The engineer checks the activity and current account state for either result.
